craft_notes: Sthāyin: triumph-joy (adbhuta). Sanskrit first: jayanti first word → L4 opens exclaiming (Victorious!) then steadies to work. Rows: row 1 (free-last — awakening caused closes). Rupture: exclamation-to-colon? No — comma restraint: triumph stated, work follows. Close: end-weight on freeing. Minimal pass: 'Victorious!' for 'They triumph' (same verb, sung). Read aloud: shout, then two labors (part, wake). Rejected: 'conquer' — killed: triumph is celebrated victory, conquest takes; 'sham' kept? — kept: asāra as sham sings, untruth preaches.

lines: Victorious, Śambhu's feet! Through the shoreless sea
they part the real from sham, and wake the knowing free.

reads_against.argmap: Śambhu's feet triumph: dividing essence from nonessence in the shoreless wandering, causing freedom-knowledge awakening.
c1_essence: Feet triumph: essence divided from nonessence, awakening caused.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder settling into quiescence)
